issues.title: National Pension Fund Reserves Shrink by 202 Trillion Won in Three Months to 1,664 Trillion Won
issues.titleKo: 국민연금 적립금, 석 달 새 202조원 줄어 1664조원
issues.summary: The National Pension Service fund's reserves stood at 1,664 trillion won at the end of September, down 202 trillion won from the end of June. Its return for January to September was 13.28 percent, about half the 27.22 percent posted in the first half.
issues.why: The National Pension is the source of the pensions today's university students will pay into and later receive, so it is worth knowing how the fund's performance is moving.

paragraphs.en: The National Pension Service's fund management headquarters said on the 27th that provisional figures for its reserves and returns at the end of September had been compiled. Reserves came to 1,664 trillion won, and the money-weighted return on the fund for January to September was 13.28 percent. At the end of June, reserves were 1,866 trillion won and the return was 27.22 percent. That means reserves fell by 202 trillion won, and the return dropped by 13.94 percentage points.
paragraphs.ko: 국민연금공단 기금운용본부는 27일 9월 말 기준 기금 적립금과 수익률이 잠정 집계됐다고 밝혔어요. 적립금은 1664조원이고, 1~9월 기금운용 수익률은 13.28%(금액가중수익률)예요. 6월 말 적립금 1866조원, 수익률 27.22%와 견주면 적립금은 202조원 줄고 수익률은 13.94%포인트 떨어졌어요.

paragraphs.en: By asset class, returns for January to September were 66.38 percent for domestic stocks and 6.61 percent for overseas stocks. Domestic bonds returned minus 3.25 percent, overseas bonds minus 7.20 percent and alternative investments minus 1.24 percent. Domestic stocks saw the biggest drop, with their return falling by 40.99 percentage points from 107.37 percent in the first half. Their market value also declined, from 543.2 trillion won to 435.2 trillion won. The return on overseas stocks slipped from 17.81 percent to 6.61 percent.

issues.title: U.S. Military Disables Merchant Ship Trying to Break Through Blockade of Iranian Ports
issues.titleKo: 미군, 이란 항만 봉쇄 뚫으려던 상선 타격해 무력화
issues.summary: U.S. Central Command said it disabled a bulk carrier in the Gulf of Oman that was trying to break the maritime blockade of Iranian ports. Iran's Revolutionary Guards publicly vowed to break the blockade, raising tensions in the Strait of Hormuz again.
issues.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a chokepoint for shipping and energy transport, so prolonged tensions could also affect international energy and logistics markets.

paragraphs.en: The U.S. military said on the 27th, local time, that it had disabled a merchant ship in the Gulf of Oman. U.S. Central Command said the vessel had tried to break through the American maritime blockade of Iranian ports. In a statement on social media, Central Command said the Palau-flagged bulk carrier Pacific Archer left Iran's Bandar Abbas port on the 26th. It said the ship then tried to cross the blockade line despite repeated warnings.
paragraphs.ko: 미군이 오만만에서 상선 한 척을 무력화했다고 현지시간 27일 밝혔어요. 이 배는 이란 항만에 대한 미국의 해상봉쇄를 돌파하려 했다는 게 미 중부사령부의 설명이에요. 중부사령부는 소셜미디어 성명에서 팔라우 선적 벌크선 퍼시픽 아처호가 26일 이란 반다르아바스항을 떠난 뒤 여러 차례 경고를 받고도 봉쇄선을 넘으려 했다고 했어요.

Central Command also released video of the strike. It added that so far 158 merchant ships that followed instructions had been turned around, while six that did not comply had been disabled.

The first blockade began in mid-April after peace talks in Islamabad, Pakistan, held right after an early April ceasefire, broke down, and it was lifted by an agreement in mid-June. A second blockade has continued since July 14 after the ceasefire collapsed in July.

issues.title: Talks on Raising Retirement Age to 65 Fail to Yield Labor-Management Deal as Panel Nears Dec. 2 Wrap-Up
issues.titleKo: 정년 65세 연장 논의, 노사 합의 못 하고 내달 2일 마무리 앞둬
issues.summary: The Democratic Party's special committee on extending the retirement age held a labor-management subcommittee meeting on the 27th for the first time in 10 months but failed to reach an agreement. The committee plans to hold its final plenary meeting on Dec. 2.
issues.why: A longer retirement age could narrow the income gap for middle-aged and older workers, but business groups worry it could weaken youth hiring, so it bears on the future job market.

paragraphs.en: The Democratic Party's special committee on extending the retirement age held a closed-door labor-management subcommittee meeting at the National Assembly on the morning of the 27th. It discussed the positions of labor and management and the committee's compromise plan but found no common ground. It was the first time in 10 months that discussions led by the ruling party had resumed. Rep. Kim Joo-young, the committee's chief secretary, said it plans to hold its final plenary meeting on Dec. 2.

issues.summary: The Jeju Office of Education will screen every student with metal detectors at all high schools starting with second-semester finals to stop cheating with AI and smart devices. The Education Ministry said it will commercialize smart glasses detection technology to prepare for next year's college entrance exam.
issues.why: Exam supervision is being tightened after the college entrance exam, from school tests to university-specific exams, so the testing environment for students may change.

paragraphs.en: The Jeju Office of Education said on the 27th that it had sent guidelines on exam administration to 30 public and private high schools. The guidelines aim to prevent cheating with mobile phones, smart glasses and ultra-small cameras and earphones. They will apply to regular exams at all high schools on the island starting with this year's second-semester finals. Middle schools will receive a separate unified set of rules based on the high school guidelines.
paragraphs.ko: 제주도교육청은 27일 휴대전화, 스마트안경, 초소형 카메라·이어폰 등을 이용한 부정행위를 막기 위한 시험관리 유의사항을 30개 공·사립 고등학교에 안내했다고 밝혔어요. 이 지침은 올 2학기 기말고사부터 도내 모든 고등학교의 정기시험에 적용돼요. 중학교는 고등학교 지침을 바탕으로 별도의 통일안을 마련해 안내할 예정이에요.

issues.summary: The National Assembly's budget adjustment subcommittee ended its work after 11 days, but votes on all Future Response Fund projects were put on hold. The remaining review will move to an informal panel, while the government separately weighs how to manage the fund's idle money.
issues.why: Support programs open to university students, such as the youth culture and arts pass, are funded through this fund, so the review outcome could affect the benefits they receive.

All projects under the Future Response Fund, a key point of contention in the government's budget proposal, had their votes put on hold. Maeil Business Newspaper reported that the review of cuts and increases for these projects is expected to move to a closed-door panel formed by the ruling and opposition chief negotiators and others.

issues.summary: On the 27th, the second day of the National Railway Workers' Union's safe-operation campaign, 445 commuter trains in the capital area ran 20 minutes or more late. The figure was nearly double the 235 on day one, and Seoul and Yongsan stations were badly crowded during the evening commute.
issues.why: University students who commute on Korail lines such as Line 1 should leave early and line up backup transportation through Dec. 4.

paragraphs.en: Around 5:30 p.m. on the 27th, the second day of the railway union's work-to-rule campaign, commuters were packed onto Lines 1, 3 and 4 and the Gyeongui-Jungang Line served by Korail. Because workers followed every work rule and operating regulation to the letter, overall service slowed, and the platforms at Seoul Station and Yongsan Station were filled with people. Some packed trains were also seen sitting for several minutes without departing because they did not shorten their stops.
paragraphs.ko: 철도노조의 준법투쟁 이틀째인 27일 오후 5시 30분께 코레일 열차가 다니는 1·3·4호선과 경의중앙선에서 퇴근길 혼잡이 벌어졌어요. 작업수칙과 운행규칙을 빠짐없이 지키느라 전체 운행이 늦어졌고, 서울역과 용산역 승강장은 사람으로 가득 찼어요. 승객이 가득 찬 열차가 정차 시간을 줄이지 않아 몇 분씩 출발하지 않는 모습도 보였어요.

issues.title: Out-of-Pocket Costs for Appendix, Uterus and Cesarean Surgeries to Fall From January Next Year
issues.titleKo: 내년 1월부터 맹장·자궁·제왕절개 수술 본인 부담 줄어요
issues.summary: The Health Ministry decided at a health insurance policy committee meeting to overhaul bundled payment rates for seven disease groups for the first time in six years, starting next January. A patient's cost for a laparoscopic appendix surgery will fall from 1.22 million won to 870,000 won.
issues.why: The news changes how much you pay at a hospital for appendix surgery or a cesarean section, so it is worth knowing.

paragraphs.en: The Ministry of Health and Welfare convened the Health Insurance Policy Deliberation Committee on the 27th. It decided to overhaul the bundled payment rates applied to seven disease groups for the first time in six years, effective January next year. Under the bundled payment system, inpatient treatment costs are set as a package according to the type of surgery rather than by adding up each test and procedure.
paragraphs.ko: 보건복지부는 27일 건강보험정책심의위원회(건정심)를 열고 7개 질병군에 적용하는 포괄수가를 6년 만에 전면 개정해 내년 1월부터 시행하기로 했어요. 포괄수가는 검사와 처치 비용을 하나씩 따지지 않고 수술 종류에 따라 입원 진료비를 묶어서 정하는 방식이에요.

sents.en: The Ministry of Health and Welfare convened the Health Insurance Policy Deliberation Committee on the 27th.
sents.ko: 보건복지부는 27일 건강보험정책심의위원회(건정심)를 열었어요.

sents.en: It decided to overhaul the bundled payment rates applied to seven disease groups for the first time in six years, effective January next year.
sents.ko: 7개 질병군에 적용하는 포괄수가를 6년 만에 전면 개정해 내년 1월부터 시행하기로 했어요.

sents.en: Under the bundled payment system, inpatient treatment costs are set as a package according to the type of surgery rather than by adding up each test and procedure.
sents.ko: 포괄수가는 검사와 처치 비용을 하나씩 따지지 않고 수술 종류에 따라 입원 진료비를 묶어서 정하는 방식이에요.

paragraphs.en: Along with rate adjustments for appendix and uterus surgeries and cesarean sections, some material costs that patients paid separately will be folded into inpatient treatment fees. Patients now pay 80 percent of the cost of items such as cutting devices and anti-adhesion agents separately on top of the fee. Going forward, patients will pay only 20 percent of the inpatient fee for appendix and uterus surgeries, and the separate charge for cesarean sections will disappear.
paragraphs.ko: 맹장·자궁 수술과 제왕절개는 수가 조정과 함께, 환자가 따로 내던 일부 재료값을 입원 진료비에 포함해요. 지금은 절삭기나 유착방지제 값의 80%를 환자가 따로 냈지만, 앞으로는 맹장·자궁 수술은 입원 진료비의 20%만 내고 제왕절개는 따로 내던 돈이 없어져요.

sents.en: Patients now pay 80 percent of the cost of items such as cutting devices and anti-adhesion agents separately on top of the fee.

paragraphs.en: For a laparoscopic appendix surgery, patients paid 1.22 million won in total. That was 700,000 won, or 20 percent of the 3.5 million won inpatient fee, plus 520,000 won, or 80 percent of the 650,000 won cutting device cost. For a laparoscopic hysterectomy, the cost falls by 470,000 won, from 1.69 million won to 1.22 million won, which is 20 percent of 6.1 million won. The 160,000 won that women undergoing cesarean sections paid separately, calculated per child, will disappear. The ministry estimated that the revision will add 113.2 billion won a year to national health insurance spending.

paragraphs.en: The uniform 30 percent surcharge on telemedicine will be abolished in January next year, and surcharges will instead apply by conditions such as nights, holidays and pediatric patients, as with in-person visits. For manual therapy, patients who have newly had surgery or suffered a fracture can receive health insurance coverage for up to 15 additional sessions, separate from their annual session count. The price per session will remain at 43,850 won. issues.title: Internet Post Office Hack Leaks Registered Mail Customer Data, 113,855 Affected in One Day
issues.titleKo: 인터넷우체국 해킹, 등기우편 고객정보 하루치만 11만여 명 유출
issues.summary: Internet Post Office was hacked using overseas IP addresses, leaking the names, addresses and phone numbers of registered mail customers. Analysis of just one day of data found 113,855 people affected, including corporations, and the total scale is still being determined.
issues.why: College students who often receive parcels and registered mail should be careful not to fall for texts or calls impersonating the post office.

paragraphs.en: Korea Post said it confirmed that Internet Post Office was hit by an outside hacking attack using overseas IP addresses, leaking personal information of customers who used registered mail. It is still working to determine the exact targets and scale of the leak.
paragraphs.ko: 우정사업본부는 인터넷우체국이 해외 IP를 이용한 외부 해킹 공격을 받아 등기우편 이용 고객의 개인정보가 유출된 사실을 확인했다고 밝혔어요. 정확한 유출 대상과 규모는 아직 파악하고 있는 단계예요.

sents.en: Korea Post said it confirmed that Internet Post Office was hit by an outside hacking attack using overseas IP addresses, leaking personal information of customers who used registered mail.
sents.ko: 우정사업본부는 인터넷우체국이 해외 IP를 이용한 외부 해킹 공격을 받아 등기우편 이용 고객의 개인정보가 유출된 사실을 확인했다고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: It is still working to determine the exact targets and scale of the leak.
sents.ko: 정확한 유출 대상과 규모는 아직 파악하고 있는 단계예요.

paragraphs.en: The hackers are believed to have accessed the mobile Internet Post Office's "recipient delivery location change service." They looked up the names, addresses and phone numbers of customers with registered mail in transit from the 17th through the 24th. The service sends a text message about the delivery to the smartphone of the person receiving the mail, so that they can choose to receive it at a place they prefer. For just one day of that period, for which analysis has been completed, 113,855 customers, including corporations, had their information leaked.
paragraphs.ko: 해커들은 모바일 인터넷우체국의 '수취인 배달장소 변경서비스'에 접근해 17일부터 24일까지 배달 중이던 등기우편물의 고객 성명, 주소, 전화번호를 조회한 것으로 파악됐어요. 이 서비스는 우편물을 받을 고객의 스마트폰으로 배달 안내 문자를 보내 원하는 장소에서 받을 수 있게 돕는 기능이에요. 이 기간 가운데 분석이 끝난 하루치만 해도 유출 고객은 11만3천855명(법인 포함)이었어요.

paragraphs.en: Korea Post learned of signs of a hacking-related leak at around 10:30 a.m. on the 25th, reported it to the Personal Information Protection Commission and asked police to investigate. Right after the hack, it temporarily suspended the delivery location change service and the non-member login service. It also fully blocked overseas IP addresses from accessing the Post Office mobile web.
paragraphs.ko: 우정사업본부는 지난 25일 오전 10시 30분께 해킹에 의한 유출 정황을 알았고, 개인정보보호위원회에 신고하고 경찰에 수사를 의뢰했어요. 해킹 직후 배달장소 변경서비스와 비회원 로그인 서비스를 임시 중단했고, 우체국 모바일 웹에 접근하는 해외 IP 주소도 전면 차단했어요.

issues.title: Bank of Korea Raises Base Rate to 3.25%, Its Third Increase in the Second Half of This Year
issues.titleKo: 한국은행, 기준금리 3.25%로 인상…올해 하반기 세 번째
issues.summary: The Bank of Korea raised its base rate by 0.25 percentage point, from 3.00 percent to 3.25 percent, at a Monetary Policy Board meeting on Nov. 26. It was the third hike in four months since July, and some observers expect high rates to continue next year.

paragraphs.en: The Bank of Korea's Monetary Policy Board raised the base rate from 3 percent to 3.25 percent on Nov. 26, at its last meeting of the year. It was the third hike in just four months since July, and two board members cast dissenting votes in favor of holding rates steady.

issues.why: When school meals and care stop, the daily lives of students and families are disrupted, and it is worth watching where the debate over education workers' pay and education funding is headed.

The Ministry of Education said that as of 11 a.m., 23,562 of the 180,722 education public service workers nationwide, or 13.0 percent, had taken part. issues.summary: The Ministry of Employment and Labor will soon announce a recommendation to keep consecutive night work to three days or fewer and to manage midnight to 4 a.m. separately as an ultra-late-night period. It targets sectors such as manufacturing, hospitals and security, but it is not legally binding.
issues.why: For college students looking for night part-time jobs or shift work, it could serve as a standard for protecting their health.

paragraphs.en: The Ministry of Employment and Labor will soon release a recommendation that employers limit consecutive night shifts to three days or fewer. Yonhap News Agency reported on the 27th, citing the labor community and related ministries, that the plan is aimed at easing the health burden on night workers.
paragraphs.ko: 고용노동부가 연속해서 야간에 일하는 날을 3일 이하로 관리하라는 권고안을 곧 내놓아요. 연합뉴스가 27일 노동계와 관계부처를 인용해 전한 내용으로, 야간 노동자의 건강 부담을 덜기 위한 안이에요.

paragraphs.en: After a night shift, workers should be given a stretch of continuous rest beyond a set number of hours, or enough time to recover. The plan also says employers should not penalize workers in personnel decisions if they ask to move to daytime work because their health has worsened.
paragraphs.ko: 야간근로를 마친 뒤에는 일정 시간 넘게 이어서 쉬거나 충분히 회복할 시간을 줘야 해요. 건강이 나빠져 낮 근무로 바꿔 달라고 하는 노동자에게 인사상 불이익을 주지 말라는 내용도 들어 있어요.

issues.title: Figure Skater Shin Ji-a Sits Second at NHK Trophy With Personal-Best 75.31 in Short Program
issues.titleKo: 피겨 신지아, 쇼트 개인 최고 75.31점으로 NHK 트로피 2위
issues.summary: Shin Ji-a set a new personal best of 75.31 points in the women's singles short program at the sixth Senior Grand Prix event in Tokyo on Nov. 27. She stands second among 12 skaters, one step closer to her first senior Grand Prix medal.
issues.why: As a Korean skater sets a new personal best and chases her first senior Grand Prix medal, attention turns to the free skate on the 28th.

paragraphs.en: Figure skater Shin Ji-a of Sehwa Girls' High School scored 75.31 points in the women's singles short program at the NHK Trophy on the 27th. The event, the sixth stop of the 2026-2027 ISU Senior Grand Prix, was held at Keio Arena Tokyo in Japan. The score combines 42.72 points for technical elements (TES) and 32.59 points for program components (PCS), and it puts her second among the 12 competitors.
paragraphs.ko: 피겨 스케이팅 여자 싱글 신지아(세화여고)가 27일 NHK 트로피 쇼트 프로그램에서 75.31점을 받았어요. 대회는 일본 도쿄 게이오 아레나 도쿄에서 열린 2026-2027 ISU 시니어 그랑프리 6차 대회예요. 기술점수(TES) 42.72점과 예술점수(PCS) 32.59점을 합친 점수로, 출전 선수 12명 중 2위에 올랐어요.
